attributes.title: Fold
attributes.lede: Scrub back through orders the timeline does not own.

lesson.concept: Commands and their ledger can come from one schedule
lesson.why: One command array generates both Perform steps and the displayed ledger. Each command's moment is derived from the holds before it, avoiding a second independent set of timestamps.
lesson.experiment: Play, seek backward across a command, and advance again. Compare the visible ledger with the actual folded state.
lesson.pitfall: An arbitrary side effect is not automatically reversible; define how the command's semantic state is rebuilt at a timestamp.
lesson.combine: Combine with playhead so ordinary button actions and recorded actions use the same reducer.
